# galaxy_file_ingest_source (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) Storage bucket
- `bucket_cloud_region_id` (String) Cloud region ID where the storage bucket lives
- `cloud_storage_credentials` (Attributes) Cloud storage credentials (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_storage_credentials))
- `name` (String) Name

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description
- `path_prefix` (String) File name prefix or path
- `secret_access_key_version` (String) Non-secret value that, when changed, triggers an update that sends the configured `cloud_storage_credentials.secret_access_key`. Use it to rotate the key.
- `source_cloud_region_id` (String) Cloud region ID where icehouse ingest work is scheduled

### Read-Only

- `file_ingest_source_id` (String) ID
- `id` (String) Terraform import identifier.
- `prefix` (String) File name prefix or path

<a id="nestedatt--cloud_storage_credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_storage_credentials`

Required:

- `credentials_type` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments))

Optional:

- `access_key_id` (String) AWS access key ID
- `external_role_arn` (String) ARN of the external IAM role
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) AWS secret access key
